_about: BMW X5 M (F85): the cluster and the iDrive screen are painted into the interior texture (phong9, 512 x 1024 px): the speedometer and rev counter, their needles painted pointing up and right. Each dial gets a moving needle (the painted one covered with its face from a little further round), the cluster glows at night, and the iDrive screen shows the centre screen's pages. Pixels of that texture; needle angles in degrees, 0 = right, 90 = down (clockwise), the dials sweeping 270 degrees from bottom left to bottom right through the top.
